title: One runner controller ·100 training stances
qualification: Fixed-clock four-stance derivative/target-free qualification passed; frozen final qualification pending.

provenance.inertial: S001 model shape transferred and mass scaled to the F01 export; provisional assumption
provenance.impedance: Selected Maxwell baseline gains from projects/impedance_instron/baseline.json; provisional transfer; ankle Cartesian experiment starts at 3000 N/m and 40 N s/m per axis
provenance.limits: Engineering envelope around F01 selected stance; provisional assumption; ankle XY bounds use measured ankle path with 0.1 m margin
provenance.com_policy: Thigh and shank at 45% of measured segment length; foot [0.025,-0.047] m from ankle in foot frame
provenance.inertia_policy: Scale model inertia by subject mass ratio and squared segment length ratio; foot by mass ratio only

source_files.name: Instron Shoe Last Size 9 6drop merged attachment 1 left.STL

shoe.registration: rigid placement only; no geometry scaling or material refit
shoe.attachment: fullfoot last and driven spring tops share one rigid carrier with fixed assembly offsets
shoe.limitations: original fixture registration retained, not a new gap-aware upper contact solve; recorded shoe may differ
shoe.side: intrinsic artifact retained; sagittal projection, no certified anatomical side

friction.source: declared contact assumptions, not identified by normal Instron loading

provenance.initialization: Unfitted training-only aligned mean nominal; no fitted controller checkpoint
provenance.controller: One shared72-coefficient curve; horizontal translation only
provenance.runtime_inputs: initial_state and initial_velocity only; material belongs to the shoe
provenance.phase_clock: Fixed train-only median period; no per-reference time stretching

dataset_policy.windows: Each identified right-foot contact is bracketed by the preceding and following local maxima of right Visual3D hip-center height; endpoints included.
dataset_policy.eval_block: Five consecutive eligible contact windows, with two eligible windows of source-time guard on either side from training.

selection: Lowest complete all100-training mean loss; evaluation excluded from updates and selection
